title: PI objectives — tranche 6 (retrospective, 2026-11-27)
body:
# PI objectives — tranche 6

## Objectives

- O1 — S06a is retired by recorded supersession, with a green receipt and no build artefacts.
- O2 — S06b's agent interface is accepted: a real agent task creates, reads, approves and
  closes a project, `decided_by_kind='agent'`, with no `nonagenticai_mcp_server` in the path.
- O3 — S10's copilot/AG-UI surface is accepted.
- O4 — S11's procedures and SOPs are accepted.
- O5 — T19F's policy-version pinning, meeting decisions and cadence materialisation gate is
  accepted.
- O6 — The tranche review decides continue or pause on the evidence.

## Business value

O1 5, O2 10, O3 9, O4 8, O5 9, O6 8 (committed: O1–O5; O6 is the review).

## Measurement

O1 by `acceptance/programme/S06a.toml`; O2 by `acceptance/programme/S06b.toml`; O3 and O4 by
their manifests; O5 by `acceptance/programme/T19F.toml` and the decision-forum gate evidence;
O6 by the tranche review.

## Evidence

The PI plan `PI plan — tranche 6 (retrospective, 2026-11-27)`, programme `01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`, tranche
`01a1e9e1-07d3-75d3-8c99-4002d5bfe8f7`, the refinement cadence `01a21c62-6a43-7d17-9d5b-836ad1801e45`, and the retention record.
